name: True Aim
description: Get 3 firearm kills in one uninterrupted life.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Get 5 firearm kills in one uninterrupted life.

name: Marksman’s Laurel
description: Get 8 firearm kills in one uninterrupted life.

name: Star of Unerring Aim
description: Repeat the 8-kill, one-life firearm feat at 3 events.

name: Medal of the Bayonet
description: Get 3 melee kills in one uninterrupted life.

name: Bayonet’s Laurel
description: Get 10 melee kills in one uninterrupted life.

name: Star of the Unbroken Line
description: Repeat the 10-kill, one-life melee feat at 3 events.

name: Steady Hand
description: Complete 2 assessed leadership rounds.

name: Trusted Voice
description: Complete 6 assessed leadership rounds across 3 events.

name: Laurel of Command
description: Complete 12 assessed leadership rounds across 5 events, including 2 rally examples.

name: Star of Distinguished Service
description: Complete 20 assessed leadership rounds across 8 events, and mentor another leader through 2 assessed rounds.

name: Faithful Service
description: Attendance recognition. Earning threshold awaiting commander approval.

name: Guiding Hand
description: Mentoring recognition. Earning criteria awaiting commander approval.

name: Officer's Mark
description: Kill an enemy officer in a linebattle.

name: Coldstream Field Aid
description: Heal 6 people in one linebattle round.

name: Keeper of the Ranks
description: As an officer, have at least half of your men survive the linebattle.

name: Return Volley
description: In a linebattle, kill the opponent who killed you in the preceding round.

name: Commander's Fall
description: In a linebattle, kill the person in charge of the opposing regiment.

name: Powder Barrel Strike
description: Kill at least 2 enemies with an explosive barrel.

name: Opening Shot
description: Get the first kill of a linebattle round.

name: Head of the Muster
description: Place first on the leaderboard in a linebattle.

name: Unbroken Sentinel
description: Survive an entire linebattle with 0 deaths.

name: Recruiting Drum I
description: Recruit 1 new member into the 2nd Coldstream Guards.

name: Recruiting Drum II
description: Recruit 4 new members into the 2nd Coldstream Guards.

name: Recruiting Drum III
description: Recruit 7 new members into the 2nd Coldstream Guards.

name: Recruiting Drum IV
description: Recruit 12 new members into the 2nd Coldstream Guards.

name: Steadfast Service
description: Be awarded recognition for exemplary service.

name: Deed of Distinction
description: Perform an astonishing deed.

name: Long Sight I
description: Kill an enemy from at least 100 metres in a linebattle.

name: Long Sight II
description: Kill an enemy from at least 120 metres in a linebattle.

name: Long Sight III
description: Kill an enemy from at least 140 metres in a linebattle.

name: Pinpoint Shot
description: Kill an enemy with a headshot from at least 100 metres in a linebattle.

name: Long Pistol
description: Get a pistol kill from at least 50 metres.

name: Three Cartridge Mark
description: Get at least 3 musket kills in one linebattle round.

name: Nice Range
description: Get a kill at a displayed distance of exactly 69 metres.

name: Bare Knuckle Mark
description: Kill an enemy using your fists.

name: Close Steel
description: Kill an enemy using a dagger.

name: Pioneer's Spade
description: Kill at least 3 enemies with a shovel.

name: Colour Bearer's Stand
description: Kill a horseman with the flag as the weapon.

name: Boot and Buckle
description: Kill an enemy with a kick.

name: Last Colour Standing
description: Be the last surviving player on your side in a linebattle, then survive and win the match.

name: Resolute Blade
description: Get at least 5 melee kills in one life.

name: Gun Deck Rupture
description: In naval play, get a kill by blowing up an enemy cannon.

name: Boarding Party's Prize
description: Board an enemy vessel and kill its captain.

name: Shoreward Shot
description: During naval play, get a kill while standing on solid ground.

name: Deckside Volley
description: In naval play, successfully volley enemies while in a line of at least 3 players.

name: First Watch
category: Game hours and length of service
description: Have at least 10 hours in Holdfast.

name: Settled Watch
category: Game hours and length of service
description: Have at least 50 hours in Holdfast.

name: Seasoned Watch
category: Game hours and length of service
description: Have at least 100 hours in Holdfast.

name: Enduring Watch
category: Game hours and length of service
description: Have at least 500 hours in Holdfast.

name: Thousand Hour Watch
category: Game hours and length of service
description: Have at least 1,000 hours in Holdfast.

name: Half Year Colours
category: Game hours and length of service
description: Be a serving member of the 2nd Coldstream Guards for 6 months.

name: Year's Colours
category: Game hours and length of service
description: Be a serving member of the 2nd Coldstream Guards for 1 year.

name: Two Year Colours
category: Game hours and length of service
description: Be a serving member of the 2nd Coldstream Guards for 2 years.

name: Eager Ensign
description: Proposed: in an opt-in, officer-approved linebattle drill, make a playful premature command call while the officer is active, then yield immediately.

name: Parade Ground Punchline
description: Amuse the event administrator during a linebattle.

name: Cuddly Recruiting Serjeant
description: Recruit someone using an approved OwO-style recruitment message. The message is awaiting commander approval.

name: Splendid Blunder
description: Proposed: make an amusing, harmless mistake during an opt-in drill, with the participant's agreement.

name: Mess Room Turncoat
description: Proposed: in an opt-in scenario agreed in advance, betray a consenting friend's fictional side or in-game position to the opposing team.

name: Ayes Have It
description: Participate in a vote whose result benefits your team.

name: Last Officer at Tea
description: Be the officer and sole survivor after everyone else in your line dies in a linebattle.

name: Wrong Door Old Chap
description: Proposed: in an administrator-approved, opt-in linebattle drill, defeat a volunteer who deliberately spawns on the wrong side.

name: Colours Renewed
description: Prestige once after reaching a qualifying rank. The Coldstream qualifying rank is awaiting commander approval.

name: Off Duty Muster
description: Recruit someone while you are not playing Holdfast.

name: First in the Queue
description: Be the first player to die in a round.

name: Double Ration
description: Be in a line that scores at least twice as many kills as its manpower during a linebattle.

name: My Own Little Company
description: Take part in a linebattle line alongside at least four people you personally recruited.

name: Orders from the Tea Tin
description: Proposed: follow an officer's deliberately absurd but harmless, event-legal order during an opt-in drill.

name: Spacey's Waterloo
description: Defeat Spacey in an authorized in-game combat encounter.

name: Coldstream Eye I
description: As a skirmisher in a linebattle, score 2 headshots in one round.

name: Coldstream Eye II
description: As a skirmisher in a linebattle, score 3 headshots in one round.

name: Coldstream Eye III
description: As a skirmisher in a linebattle, score 4 headshots in one round.

name: Through the Powder Smoke
description: As a skirmisher in a linebattle, kill an enemy you cannot see.

name: Little Sword's Reply
description: As a light/skirmisher in a linebattle, get two sword kills.

name: Light Company's Giant
description: As a light/skirmisher in a linebattle, kill a Grenadier.

name: Three Sorts Sent Packing
description: As a skirmisher in a linebattle, kill enemies from three different classes in a single round.

name: Counter Picket
description: As a skirmisher in a linebattle, kill an enemy skirmisher with a headshot.

name: First Ball Home
description: As a skirmisher in a linebattle, kill an enemy with your first shot of the round.

name: Borrowed Horse Borrowed Glory
description: Play as cavalry for the first time in a linebattle.

name: Saddle Star I
description: As cavalry in a linebattle, get 3 kills on horseback in one round.

name: Saddle Star II
description: As cavalry in a linebattle, get 5 kills on horseback in one round.

name: Saddle Star III
description: As cavalry in a linebattle, get 7 kills on horseback in one round.

name: Broad Sweep
description: As cavalry in a linebattle, get two kills with one swing of your sabre.

name: Standard Has Spoken
description: As cavalry in a linebattle, be killed while on horseback by a flagbearer.

name: Mind the Horse
description: As cavalry in a linebattle, kill an enemy by running them over on horseback.

name: Empty Stable
description: As cavalry in a linebattle, lose your horse in the line of duty.

name: Rose Coloured Charger
description: As cavalry in a linebattle, spawn on a pink horse.

name: Gunner's Decade
description: As artillery in a linebattle, kill 10 enemies with a cannon. The counting window is unresolved; one round is proposed.

name: Howitzer Laurel
description: As artillery in a linebattle, record 10 enemy kills with a howitzer in one round.

name: Mortar Laurel
description: As artillery in a linebattle, record 10 enemy kills with a mortar in one round.

name: Rocket Troop Distinction
description: As artillery in a linebattle, record 10 enemy kills with rockets in one round.

name: Battery Breaker Medal
description: As artillery in a linebattle, destroy 2 enemy artillery pieces in one round.

name: Canister Cluster Medal
description: As artillery in a linebattle, record 3 enemy kills with one canister of grapeshot.

name: Ramrod Honour
description: As artillery in a linebattle, record 1 enemy kill with a ramrod.

name: First Muster Medal
description: Attend 1 regimental training session.

name: Bronze Musketry Proficiency
description: Obtain basic proficiency in musketry.

name: Silver Musketry Proficiency
description: Obtain advanced proficiency in musketry.

name: Gilt Musketry Proficiency
description: Demonstrate mastery of musketry.

name: Bronze Close Combat Proficiency
description: Obtain basic proficiency in melee.

name: Silver Close Combat Proficiency
description: Obtain advanced proficiency in melee.

name: Gilt Close Combat Proficiency
description: Demonstrate mastery of melee.

name: Bronze Attached Battery Proficiency
description: Obtain basic proficiency in artillery.

name: Silver Attached Battery Proficiency
description: Obtain advanced proficiency in artillery.

name: Gilt Attached Battery Proficiency
description: Demonstrate mastery of artillery.

name: Bronze Light Company Fieldcraft Proficiency
description: Obtain basic proficiency in skirmishing.

name: Silver Light Company Fieldcraft Proficiency
description: Obtain advanced proficiency in skirmishing.

name: Gilt Light Company Fieldcraft Proficiency
description: Demonstrate mastery of skirmishing.

name: Bronze Mounted Detachment Proficiency
description: Obtain basic proficiency in cavalry.

name: Silver Mounted Detachment Proficiency
description: Proposed subject pending confirmation: obtain advanced proficiency in cavalry.

name: Gilt Mounted Detachment Proficiency
description: Demonstrate mastery of cavalry.
